Experimental local-width audit

5,288 solo icons scanned, including variants. 625 flagged at a 2px minimum narrow-run length; 325 currently pass gallery QA. 260 of these flags were absent from the older internal-spacing checker. Keeping existing internal-review findings as well produces 695 review candidates, including 368 currently passing icons. The prototype does not reproduce 70 old findings, so it should supplement the old checker. No source changes or scan errors were observed during this snapshot.

These are review candidates, not confirmed design failures. Existing production rules and icon drawings are unchanged. Red = sustained narrow region; blue = sampled distance across it. Negative clear gaps indicate opposing strokes overlap.

Trial parameters: 0.25px samples, 8px centerline / 4px clear-ink requirement, 8px local contour-distance exclusion, opposing-boundary direction filter, unobstructed centerline connector. Complete circles are delegated to existing hole checks. This sampled prototype is not a certified geometric distance gate; threshold tuning and visual review remain necessary.
